Build-time dependencies, vendored for offline and reproducible DMG layout generation:

- ds-store 1.3.1: https://github.com/dmgbuild/ds_store (MIT)
- mac-alias 2.2.2: https://github.com/dmgbuild/mac_alias (MIT)

Installed from their published Python wheels with `pip --target --no-compile --no-deps`.
Original source, package metadata and licenses are retained. These libraries are
used only by the packaging script and are not included in the application.
